messages:
Gwen H: quick sync / packaging Datadog + OpenTelemetry bundle for the HW marketplace. need a concise ops pack for partners.
Tarek S: list of must-haves?
Gwen H: OTEL collector example, span attribute guidance, a small dashboard JSON, runbook bullets (rotate/retention), and a short demo.
Min J: partner asks for model_family, model_id, batch_size on spans. quant_mode only when not default to keep cardinality low.
Sofia R: sampling: baseline low (3-5%), but capture 100% for errors and traces > 500ms. OTEL tail_sampling + local limiter recommended.
Min J: snippet to share (minimal):
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
      - name: error_policy
        type: string_attribute
        string_attribute:
          key: "error"
          values: ["true"]
      - name: slow_policy
        type: latency
        latency:
          threshold_ms: 500
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}
```
Tarek S: include link pattern for dashboards: `Marketplace / Integrations / <Partner> / Model / <model_family> / Inference`. keeps things consistent.
Gwen H: runbook note: rotate otel logs, keep traces 7d, metrics 30d, and recommend fallback to metric-only tiles if high-card spans appear. include logrotate example.
Sofia R: QA: can run telemetry-loadgen to simulate varied batch_size and seq_len. repo: https://git.internal/redwood/obs-qa-tool (see /scripts/load).
build-bot: Calendar created: "Marketplace obs dry-run" Mon 14:00 PT / attendees: Gwen H, Tarek S, Min J, Sofia R.
Gwen H: thanks team. i'll assemble the bundle after dry run and open the marketplace PR. tagging legal for announcement text. :thumbsup:
